text:
The carnation needed only to see itself defeated

by the lip where it appeared, when, emboldened,

with its own shame, its crimson hue

seemed more like your ruby.


Though in your lovely mouth it was not divided

and showered among white pearls,

your anger, mistaking it for your lip,

left the lip bitten like a carnation.


Had it not feared for the blood,

so that, aspiring to Tyrian scarlet,

it might learn from your liquid purple.


Your sovereign mouth shed blood

so a red victory might dawn:

tears for the carnation, laughter for the morning.

translation.title: A Aminta, que teniendo un clavel en la boca
